name_en: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board - member benefits
department: Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Construction workers who join the Board can get help money: Rs 1,000 pension a month after 60, Rs 500 family pension a month, Rs 2,00,000 if a member dies in an accident, Rs 5,00,000 if a worker dies at the work site (even if not a member), Rs 50,000 on natural death, Rs 5,000 for funeral costs, Rs 20,000 for marriage, Rs 18,000 for having a baby, money for children's studies, up to Rs 500 for glasses, and up to Rs 4,00,000 for a house.

other: You must do manual work in construction or upkeep of dams, bridges, roads or buildings, stone breaking or crushing, brick making, or putting up pandals.
For the pension, you must be a registered member aged 60 or more (or younger if sickness has made you unable to work).

how_to_apply: Register online on the Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Board website (New Registration). There is no registration fee. You get an ID card. Renew your membership on time. Claims for help money and renewal are also done online.
where_to_apply: tnuwwb.tn.gov.in (online), from home or a nearby service centre
go_number: G.O. No 421 (Labour & Employment (I2) Department) dated 27.12.2013 (pension raised to Rs 1,000)
